tickets.title: Provider token expired on Pasifik Media stream (Room 402)
tickets.symptom: Guest in Room 402 sees "Channel temporarily unavailable (Code: TOKEN_EXPIRED)" on sports & news channels.
observedFacts: Endpoint E-09 heartbeat is Online (last seen 13:58 WIB).
GOJJA App Shell v2.4.0 is responsive; Hotel Info channel plays normally.
Provider connection CT-02 reported HTTP 401 TokenExpired from headend gateway.
tickets.diagnosticInference: Upstream provider authentication token for CT-02 has expired; this is a provider credential lifecycle issue, not an Android TV hardware or GOJJA APK crash.
tickets.suggestedNextAction: Refresh provider secret reference in TV Services → Provider Connection and run TV-side connection probe.
tickets.limitationsNote: Read-only diagnostic assistant. Cannot autonomously modify provider credentials or reset TV.

tickets.title: Staged media asset download interrupted on Room 202 TV
tickets.symptom: Publication PUB-01 shows 5/7 Applied; E-05 remains on config v3.
observedFacts: Endpoint E-05 lost Wi-Fi connectivity at 12:00 WIB during staging of welcome-arunika.mp4.
Atomic manifest guard retained last known valid configuration v3 without corrupting active theme.
tickets.diagnosticInference: Room 202 keycard power or local AP connection dropped before checksum verification completed.
tickets.suggestedNextAction: Verify room power/AP in Room 202; endpoint will automatically resume staging and ACK v4 upon reconnect.
tickets.limitationsNote: Read-only diagnostic assistant. Cannot power on physical TV panel remotely when AC power is cut.

candidates.notes: Reachable over hospitality VLAN. Waiting for on-TV RSA debugging authorization prompt confirmation.
Advertised Android TV Remote service via mDNS, but TCP port 5555 connection timed out. Do not assume developer mode is off—check VLAN ACL or wireless debugging pairing port.
Open cast/HTTP port only; no ADB daemon or supported Android TV management route.

discoveryRuns.summaryText: Simulated mDNS + bounded /24 probe completed in 12s. Found 3 candidates (1 ADB AuthRequired, 1 Unreachable hint, 1 Non-Android Cast port).
